note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh; re-verified for this job 2026-10-09: mat/mrk/luk/jhn/1co/2co return 200 as usfm/, psa/pro/isa/jer/dan 404). The mirror carries no Old Testament, so OT quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work that quotes the same verse (source_file names it), and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

A `mined` row was re-measured against the finished text by script: every quoted fragment is an exact substring both of that block and of the cited 1962 NT verse or corpus file. Mark 16:15a («ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ሂዱ») is short but is the whole of what the English quotes and is the verse's exact opening, so it is counted mined.

The English epigraphs are simplified child paraphrases ("— from Psalm 139"); as in the shipped am children's editions, each quotes the 1962 wording for the part the English means, with … for words left out, and cites `— ከ<Book> <chapter>`. Jeremiah 31:3 reuses grace-abounding.am.json's «በዘላለም ፍቅር ወድጄሃለሁ» but its second clause ("with kindness I have drawn you") is composed, so it is self_rendered. 1 Corinthians 3's epigraph is the verbatim wording of 3:12, whose last clause carries the "each one's work will be shown" sense the English gives. Chapter 3's inline list of building materials is Paul's 1962 vocabulary re-cast as a list, so self_rendered. John 12:24 matches talks-to-the-farmer-children.am.json's epigraph exactly.

No Amharic full or teen edition of this life exists yet, so names follow the shipped am corpus: ኤሚ ካርማይክል, ዶህናቩር, አማ (brave-for-god.am, women-who-moved-heaven-2.am), ኬዝዊክ, ኩዌከር, የቻይና የውስጥ ሚስዮን, ሴይሎን, ታሚል.
